decisions.reason: Adding a tenth badge could require a new award trigger, while removing Legend could require retiring its award behavior, but the client chose neither option and supplied no corresponding trigger or milestone change.
The FAQ describes badges generically and does not state their catalog count, row layout, or inclusion of the Legend badge.
The About page only mentions badges as a general gamification feature; the badge-row presentation choice does not require changing that content.
The source changes badge catalog presentation, not landing-page referral, commission, or prize mechanics copy.
Badge-row completion has no effect on the landing-page book cover's placement, size, or visibility.
The badge catalog decision does not change the landing-page hero's text, layout, or visual emphasis.
The Mission page references badges and achievements only generically and remains valid regardless of the catalog's row-completion option.
The badge catalog presentation choice does not affect the current or planned product names.
Badge count and row layout do not change referral-code identity, sharing, display, or resale behavior.
The aesthetic badge-row choice is unrelated to the connected-wallet USDC mint flow.
The badge catalog choice does not alter secondary-sale royalties, token standards, or marketplace enforcement.
Badge-row presentation does not affect automatic prize delivery or any prize-claim behavior.
